_what: Doug's marks on docs/review/concept-repairs-2026-10-19.html, pasted in chat 2026-10-20 (Copy my marks), kept verbatim. The tithe note is from his chat message of the same morning: it was typed on the sheet but came back empty in the copy.

d1-add-verses.note: looks good - two need more discussion:  is Israel of title or something deeper like a group identity?  it is the decendents of Israel (aka Jacob)  - and is Gold an image in Matt 2:11 or a type of gift - a thing essentially - I do agree that is is a symbollic thing, but the symbollism is the reading and the tangible is the obvious

d2-drop-words.note: agree with the recommendation - but on comment that I am not a fan of the word "stupid" which carries some baggage - what about "foolish"?  That seems to be the dominant word in Proverbs, but subtly can reference actions as well as the individual - which I think gives more room for interpretation regarding the shepherds

d5:the_tithe.note_from_chat: maybe there is a related concept of a tenth which has a tie to tithe - I feel like the bridge should be there

rulings_2026-10-20._how: asked in chat as three decision cards after the measurements below; each answered with the recommended option
rulings_2026-10-20.israel_title: Move to the people: the 73 go to children_of_israel (group), still judged and credited; the title card keeps only verses about the naming (Gen 32:28, 35:10).
rulings_2026-10-20.image_gold: Plain gold; image by figure: all 53 go to the plain gold card; the image card gains a verse only where gold is used as a figure, asked as its own question. The house rule (Matt 7:24-25) applied to adds as well as ends.
rulings_2026-10-20.stupid: Renamed 'senseless': the Berean's word where the word does mean the card (Jer 10:21); no baggage, covers acts as well as people, collides with nothing.
rulings_2026-10-20.d1_rest: 'looks good': the other adds as recommended.

measured_on_his_points.israel_title: 73 verses proposed to add, by the words g2474 and h3479; the sampled ones are all the people (1 Cor 10:18, 2 Cor 3:7, Acts 1:6, Acts 10:36, Acts 13:17), which is children_of_israel (group), not the name given to Jacob (title).
measured_on_his_points.image_gold: 53 verses proposed to add, the same 53 as the plain gold card (concept); mostly tangible gold (1 Pet 3:3 jewelry, 1 Tim 2:9, 1 Cor 3:12). Same failure as the house of Matt 7:24-25: a card's words cannot tell the figure from the thing.
measured_on_his_points.stupid: two records named 'stupid' (vile, concept; vile_assessment, assessment, Job 18:3); 'foolish' is already a record (assessment, Titus 3:3) beside fool, fools, folly and foolishness, so a rename to 'foolish' collides.
